run_neutts_synth_cli: run the NeuTTS CLI to synthesize speech from text using a reference voice audio and transcript
create_wav_output: create a WAV file from float32 audio samples using pure struct packing without soundfile
synthesize_voice_clone: synthesize speech in a cloned voice using reference audio, reference text, and target text
configure_tts_model_device: configure the NeuTTS model backbone repo and compute device for CPU, CUDA, or MPS inference
validate_reference_inputs: validate that reference audio and reference text files exist before running synthesis
